The kinetic energy of a body with mass m and velocity v is E=1/2mv². The
identity a²−b²=(a−b)(a+b) holds for all real numbers. A definite integral
for review is f¹₊x²dx=1/3. The sequence rule can be written as aₙ₊₁=qaₙ
for n≥1. Totals for the table below. Alpha stands for 45 units and Beta
stands for 60 units, so the sum is 105 units.
